description: In-game verify pixel-art VFX gate. Cast slot 1 (tobor_spider_mines, PLACED) and snap DURING the VFX window (~0.15s) so the pixel-art frames are on screen. The placed mines should show pixel-art AbilityVfx under the new gate; under old code (if not vector_only) it also showed. Then cast slot 0 (steam_keg, non-placed, vector-only) and snap during that window - NO pixel-art should be present in either old or new code.
